Expo standards: build robust, performant, maintainable cross-platform apps with modern React Native and Expo.

Structure: `assets/` (images, fonts); `src/` (app logic), with `src/components/`, `src/screens/`, `src/navigation/` (if not using Expo Router), `src/hooks/`, `src/utils/`, `src/services/`. Use `kebab-case` directories, `PascalCase` components, and `camelCase` hooks/utils, variables/functions. Use `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE` for global constants.

Use functional components, TypeScript, and centralized `StyleSheet` styling. Always use functional components. All new code must be in TypeScript.

Use file-based routing via Expo Router’s `app/` directory, not a single-file manual stack/tab setup for all routes. Examples: `app/_layout.tsx`, `app/index.tsx` (`/`), `app/profile/[id].tsx` (`/profile/:id`).

Manage state efficiently and immutably. Always create new objects/arrays when updating state. Carefully manage `useEffect` dependency arrays to avoid unnecessary re-renders or infinite loops.

Use `.env` client variables with the `EXPO_PUBLIC_` prefix (e.g. `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL`; access via `process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL`). Never store sensitive keys (e.g., private API keys) in `EXPO_PUBLIC_` variables. They are bundled client-side. Use EAS Secrets for server-side secrets.

Optimize UX: use `React.memo` for pure components; `useCallback` and `useMemo` for props to memoized components or expensive computations; lazy-load large-app screens with `React.lazy` and `Suspense`.

Handle async errors with `try/catch`, log failures (e.g. `console.error('Failed to fetch data:', error)`) and show user-friendly messages. Add a global error boundary at `src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx`, wrapping the app in `App.tsx` or `_layout.tsx`.

Testing: use Jest & React Testing Library for component logic and user interactions; Aim for ≥80% coverage. Avoid no tests or shallow-only tests. Example path: `src/components/Button.test.tsx`. Use `render`, `fireEvent`, and assertions for interactions. Snapshot-test UI components with `react-test-renderer` and `toMatchSnapshot()`.
